note: Unit figures for soft-tissue surgical robots, one row per company per metric per period. Almost nothing here is fetchable: two companies publish an auditable series and the rest have to be read out of filings by hand. Rules, in order of importance. (1) `basis` is REQUIRED and closed to config.UNIT_BASIS, and it records the COMPANY'S OWN counting rule, not ours. Intuitive PLACES systems, including under operating lease and usage-based terms, and does not split them; Edge Medical reports systems 'installed or delivered'; Surgerii's prospectus reports production and sales as two different rows; MedBot reports orders apart from installs. Four companies, four meanings of the word units. Nothing downstream may sum across bases. (2) `geography` is REQUIRED. Procept's quarterly figures are United States only, and a global count circulates that its own release does not contain; stored without a geography that US number would be set against Intuitive's worldwide fleet and understate Procept. (3) `value` must be positive; a zero is a parse failure, not a count. (4) `placement_model` where the company says, because a leased system and a sold system are not the same event. (5) Every row needs a source URL, a publication date, a `last_checked` date and a `caveat` written for a reader. (6) Never delete a superseded figure; add the new one and let the page show the revision.
